title: A Paper About a Barn
subtitle: 战争与和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争与和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争与和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：agreement　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 agreement 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my grandmother's brother came home with one ① agreement in his pocket, which was not a peace treaty but a paper about a barn, and he said the two things are the same shape. The ② agreement was signed by nine men in a room with one window, and he said he had been the only one who could read it, and that this had not helped; an agreement, he said, is a promise made by people who will not be there.

They ③ reached an agreement about the barn in one hour and about the field in eight years, and he said the difference was that everybody wanted the barn. My grandfather was ④ in agreement with him about the barn and about nothing else in thirty-one years, and my grandmother said being in agreement about one thing is the whole of a marriage.

There was ⑤ an agreement on the water in 1952, written on the back of the other one, and it held for nine years and then did not. He said an  agreement is only as good as the number of people who want it to last, and that the number is usually one, and my grandmother said he had learned that in a room with one window.

In 1961 my father told him that a verb and its subject had to be in ⑥ agreement, meaning grammar, and he said he had spent his life on the other kind and did not intend to start now. There was ⑦ no agreement at all between what he said that year and what he had written in 1945, and my grandmother said a man may agree with the facts and still not agree with himself; agreement, she said, is not the same as being right.

They came to an ⑧ agreement in 1964 that he would not come back, and he did not, and neither of them ever said why. The  agreement I would sign, if there were one, is not the barn or the field or the water; an agreement, my father said in 1996, is the only thing two people can make that outlasts both of them, and theirs lasted eight years.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 同意；一致的意见
D. n. （语法上的）一致；呼应
E. 固定搭配：reach / come to an agreement 达成协议
F. 固定搭配：in agreement with ... 与……意见一致
G. 固定搭配：sign an agreement 签署协议
H. 固定搭配：an agreement on / about ... 关于……的协议

items.q: The agreement was signed by nine men
reached an agreement about the barn
was in agreement with him about the barn
an agreement on the water in 1952
had to be in agreement, meaning grammar
There was no agreement at all between

answers.why: agreement 意为“协议、协定”，1945 年他口袋里揣着一份协议回来，那其实是一张关于谷仓的纸。
sign an agreement 意为“签署协议”，那份协议由九个人在一间只有一个窗户的屋子里签署。
reach an agreement 意为“达成协议”，关于谷仓他们一小时就达成了协议，关于那块地却用了八年。
in agreement with ... 意为“与……意见一致”，祖父在谷仓这件事上与他意见一致，三十一年里在其他事上都不一致。
an agreement on ... 意为“关于……的协议”，1952 年就用水达成了一项协议，写在另一份协议的背面。
agreement 意为“（语法上的）一致、呼应”，1961 年父亲告诉他动词和主语必须一致。
agreement 意为“相符、吻合”，他 1961 年说的话与 1945 年写下的东西完全不相符。
agreement 意为“同意、一致的意见”，1964 年他们达成了一致：他不再回来。
